title: Lighting a quiet interview
creator: Mina Park
transcript: Place the key light close to the guest, soften it with diffusion, and keep the background one stop darker for a calm studio interview.

title: Clean dialogue outside
creator: Ravi Chen
transcript: A windscreen and careful microphone placement preserve speech on location. Record room tone before leaving the scene.

title: Finding the opening beat
creator: Elena Ortiz
transcript: Start a short edit on the clearest visual change, then let the first spoken line answer the question created by that image.
